study.question: Does reading the full event under an arithmetic mixture of target-field retrieval distributions improve over aligned field-only reads, and does the previous separate-versus-consensus gain reflect value alignment or geometric opinion pooling?
study.hypothesis: Observed: action-mean directional fusion reached only AUC 0.6114152265, below DIN 0.6133619861; within that family target queries and directional gates helped, but did not establish transfer of an industry architecture. Event-level target-separated retrieval subsequently reached 0.6153351064 versus target consensus 0.6146090565, history-context separated 0.6110239483 and history-context consensus 0.6108756757. The target readout interaction is 0.0005777772 AUC on one seed, without uncertainty estimates. All four event variants had identical 17130275 parameters. Candidate-supplied diagnostics on only the first 512 impressions reported field-attention L1 1.4855301 and separate/consensus cosine 0.9208232, with norm error below 1e-6. The preceding contrast changed both probability pooling (two distributions versus geometric consensus) and field-to-value assignment. It cannot identify which caused the gain. Mechanism hypothesis: an event retrieved through one reliable field may contain useful counterpart-field evidence that aligned reads discard; arithmetic whole-event pooling retains such evidence without geometric suppression. This is an unconfirmed mechanism, and strong field disagreement could instead make counterpart values harmful. The category-match-present slice was 0.6125554423 for aligned versus 0.6120185715 for consensus (2516922 impressions, 129821 positives, 2387101 negatives); the absent slice was 0.6183087997 versus 0.6183456808 (717129, 29616, 687513). These exploratory patterns motivate checking whether union helps complementary evidence or merely dilutes reliable matches.

nearest_work.difference: DIN already uses target-conditioned weighted event pooling. This local candidate keeps the existing shallow relation scorer and two field queries, and isolates arithmetic versus geometric opinion pooling and aligned versus crossed event values. Original DIN explicitly abandons softmax to preserve interest intensity; our inherited softmax and pooled-norm matching are deliberate task-specific controls, not an exact DIN reproduction or a new attention claim.

Same encoder, shared scorer, parameter shapes/order, static MLP and norm rule. Substitute average field probabilities applied to the full event for aligned field-specific values. Replayed as aligned_replay. Crossed replacement makes the new raw summary exactly half aligned plus half crossed, up to floating point rounding.

Both arithmetic-union candidate and existing geometric-consensus control read the same full-event values with the same two scores and capacity. Only probability combination changes. This comparator is essential to avoid conflating value alignment with the form of opinion pooling.

Field-to-sequence retrieval and multiple views are existing ideas. No generated query probes, refined field-sequence bridge, extra embedding views or stacked attention are adopted. Our difference is a zero-parameter replacement of probability/value routing in the local model. No literature-wide novelty has been verified.

No co-evolving buses, FM Highway, gated sequence projection, extra heads, mutual learning or auxiliary labels. Earlier declared channel-gate use produced a losing local trajectory, which does not test or refute the original method. This suite tests probability/value coupling instead.

nearest_work.difference: Only the author README and its category/brand/type field limitation are available; publisher full text remains blocked. No historical item ID, DMR user-item module or auxiliary matching objective is invented; this is not a DMR reproduction.

inherited_components: Host-frozen causal prefixes, all first-six-day exposures, natural class ratio, history cap 128, batch 4096, three epochs, seed 42, fixed labels/scorer and sample identities.

Shared static/history category and brand embeddings, action and log2-age embeddings, d=16, one [4d,64,1] PReLU relation scorer shared across fields, [128,64] ReLU MLP, default host Adam and unmodified loss/lr=0.001.

Independent masked category/brand attention distributions and target-independent masked-mean reference norm; exact empty-history and degenerate-summary fallback inherited from g2-r0001-target_separate.

All models retain a d-dimensional history output, identical active parameter shapes and 17130275 parameters under the current metadata. No new data, token budget, learned projections, optimizer or training objective.
study.proposed_difference: Let c_i,b_i,u_i denote category, brand and common action+recency event values; p_c,p_b are independently normalized field-query probabilities. Aligned A=sum_i[p_c*c_i+p_b*b_i+(p_c+p_b)*u_i/2]. Crossed X swaps the category and brand probabilities on c_i,b_i only. Candidate U=sum_i[(p_c+p_b)*(c_i+b_i+u_i)/2]=(A+X)/2 before norm matching. Existing consensus G uses softmax((s_c+s_b)/2) on the same whole event, equivalent to a normalized geometric mean of p_c and p_b on valid positions. U versus A isolates counterpart-value inclusion at fixed field scores, parameters and output width; U versus G isolates arithmetic versus geometric probability pooling. Every selected summary is matched to its own model masked-mean reference norm per impression; this does not force different trained models to share embedding values or absolute norms. All variants compute the same set of raw readouts; unused branches do not affect predictions or gradients. This is a mechanism experiment, not a claim of deployment-optimal cost.
predictions: Predeclared primary: union_target exceeds aligned_replay by at least 0.0002 full-population validation AUC and exceeds existing g2-r0001-target_consensus, with Logloss and measured cost reported. The 0.0002 is a practical decision threshold, not a significance test.

If counterpart event evidence is complementary, union_target should exceed crossed_target as well as aligned_replay. If crossed_target alone wins or union merely lies between endpoints, prefer a value-routing or smoothing explanation over complementary evidence.

A target-specific benefit predicts a positive interaction: [union_target-aligned_replay] - [union_context-g2-r0001-context_separate] > 0. If this is absent, describe any gain as a general pooling change rather than a target-conditioned mechanism.

At any frozen checkpoint, raw U=(A+X)/2, valid attention sums are one, empty histories yield zero history summaries and selected norms match reference norms within floating point tolerance. Changed routing must yield nontrivial union/aligned or union/geometric direction differences to support its intended implementation.

Report pre-existing history-length, category-match, behavior-presence, hour and user-frequency slices with their authorized sample/positive/negative counts. Match-present/absent trends are exploratory; no per-slice hypothesis tests or new data-dependent cutpoints. Inspect empty-history behavior as a shared-training spillover control, not as direct evidence of history retrieval.
falsifiers: Union fails the +0.0002 primary AUC threshold against aligned replay, or worsens Logloss materially: no supported improvement from whole-event value inclusion under this recipe; preserve aligned incumbent and all negative outcomes.

Union beats geometric consensus but not aligned replay: geometric suppression is a plausible limitation of the prior consensus implementation; there is no evidence that full-event values improve on field-aligned evidence.
Union gains equally with history-only queries, or crossed alone explains its gain: reject target-specific complementarity as the supported explanation.

Aligned replay does not reproduce the prior starting point to within 0.0001 AUC: investigate source/config/seed execution and selection differences before comparing historical controls. Do not tune against that discrepancy or silently discard its cost.

Any nonfinite logit, mask leakage, significant decomposition/norm error (diagnostic absolute norm error >1e-4), changed sample coverage or protocol mismatch invalidates the affected comparison. Stop interpretation and retain the failure receipt.
alternative_explanations: Arithmetic pooling can alter entropy, regularization and gradient flow, rather than recover semantically useful counterpart fields; crossed control, geometric comparator and entropy/direction diagnostics discriminate partially but cannot prove semantics.

Different end-to-end learned embeddings and scorer calibration remain part of the intervention. Fixed output norms within a model do not eliminate across-training scale changes or optimization-path effects.

One seed and reused validation data leave seed variability, multiple comparisons and checkpoint-selection noise unresolved. First-512 candidate diagnostics are a restricted, nonrandom sample and not independently verified population evidence.

Category/brand hash collisions and missing fields can distort bucket-equality diagnostics. Counts refer to supplied prefixes capped at 128, not complete lifetime history; no unavailable item identity is assumed.

Static snapshot as-of dates are undocumented; inherited temporal benchmark assumptions do not establish production point-in-time validity. External pCVR/multi-domain results are not transferable local CTR evidence.

contrasts.decision_if_supported: Advance only a practical gain with valid replay and implementation diagnostics; call it preliminary local evidence, then repeat selected candidate and closest controls on paired seeds.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: Keep incumbent. A negative result supports retaining aligned evidence under this implementation, not a universal rejection of cross-field event information.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: Runtime protocol estimated_unit_seconds=704.3729729604242; g2-r0001-target_separate wall=646.8658979088068 seconds, inference=18.347554117441177 seconds, peak GPU=961638912 bytes. Four prior event variants cost 646.9-675.7 seconds each. Remaining budget at entry=80891.50377202034 seconds; cap=1760.9324324010606 seconds/trial.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Count all four new variants, including incumbent replay and negative crossed/history-only controls. Plan 900 seconds each (3600 total), worst-case four host caps about 7044 seconds. Reserve at least 12000 further seconds for discriminating attribution/replay failures; no duplicate retries for unknown execution state. Preparation, source reads, static checks and diagnostics consume the same ledger.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve at least 12000 seconds for validation-only paired seeds 42/43/44 of the eventual selected model and closest two controls (nine runs at 900 seconds=8100, plus contingency). Freeze source/config hashes and suite first; count available seed-42 results when identical. No test feedback or closed archive access is authorized. Missing uncertainty or repetitions must be reported explicitly.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Host enforces hard budget and per-trial cap; never raise them. Do not launch training here. Submit the four standalone modules for host execution. After measured receipts, pursue only an admissible discriminating experiment while preserving reserves; prefer the incumbent if gains are null or invalid. No equal-compute or mechanism-success claim from one seed. Stop if integrity fails or no useful experiment fits.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Primary arxiv:2609.16548v1 section 4.2 lines 128-183 read. Multiple views and field-to-history retrieval are prior work. Local factorial evidence supports target queries, but does not establish a query-generation bottleneck or justify the larger bridge.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: No QueryFormer component adopted. Fix the two existing field queries and isolate probability pooling/value routing with zero extra parameters.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: No generated probes, co-transformer, query refinement or independently parameterized views. Arithmetic and crossed-value replacements distinguish the local readout mechanism; no novelty or reproduction claim.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: A local union failure tests only this readout. It does not test QueryFormer or its reported scaling frontier.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Retrieved organizer-only card supplies no original implementation or full ablation evidence; detailed original mechanism remains unverified. Local field-readout gains do not establish token-budget constraints.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: No projected joint tokenization, learned allocation or gated decoder. Keep all supplied events and the fixed d-vector output.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: A fixed algebraic change to existing event values, without changing token count or capacity. Detailed source comparison and priority remain unresolved.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: A failure of whole-event reads cannot establish the value or failure of source tokenization or asymmetric capacity allocation.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Primary arxiv:2608.16797v1 lines 163-207 read and latest declared usage reviewed against executed trajectories. The earlier gate adaptation improved within family but all four variants lost to DIN; later event retrieval gains do not confirm UniDot transfer.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: No UniDot-specific component used. Continue the event-level branch; change only how existing field scores read event values, with crossed and context replacements.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: No parallel buses, per-layer interaction, FM Highway, conditional SwiGLU, mutual learning, auxiliary labels or optimizer changes. Existing target-aware pooling is inherited; the proposed distinction is a controlled local intervention.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: Null union or crossed controls reject only the local coupling hypothesis. They neither validate nor refute the external architecture.
